entries.why: the weapon choice had to be whispered to King Hresvelgr, the hostile level 46 monster just killed (step type 9 has no talk truce); period: "Head back to Averrius and he will ask you for your weapon choice" - the choice is now made at Averrius
choose target and marker move from King Hresvelgr (Varulvhamn) to Averrius in Gna Faste; the seven Varulbane choices are unchanged
